title: Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations: Posting the Therapeutic Opening Charge
content:
**Desk reference — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.** The **therapeutic opening charge** is the private bed-hold charge on the therapeutic opening entry: the opening entry of a released Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold that carries more than one resident-private entry — the resident-private entry beginning on the reservation's recorded first privately held day. The business office posts the therapeutic opening charge once the entry is booked.

The charge belongs to a Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold, a home or community visit of a privately paying resident, whose reservation has been released and carries more than one resident-private held-days entry; the entry it prices is the opening one, the entry that begins on the first privately held day the reservation records.

### What the posting does

The charge is recorded on the reservation's ledger, dated the day it is posted, naming the held-days entry it prices and the number of held days it bills, and the reservation's bed-hold balance rises by the amount. The posted charge and its reference number show on the receipt.

### Invocation

`post_therapeutic_opening_charge_78fe9a0a` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bedhold_reservation_id` | the reference number of the bed-hold reservation the charge belongs to, as shown on the reservation record | text reference |
| `days_entry_id` | the reference number of the booked resident-private held-days entry being charged, as shown on the reservation's ledger | text reference |
| `day_count` | the number of held days the charge bills; it is recorded as the charge's day count | a whole number of at least 1, in days |
| `amount` | the bed-hold charge | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded half up to the cent |

No parameter takes an enumerated value.

### Return

A one-line text receipt: "Posted therapeutic opening charge <charge reference> on reservation <reservation reference> for held-days entry <entry reference>: <days> days, <amount> USD posted <posting date>; bed-hold balance now <balance> USD." The references echo those given, the days are a whole number, the amount and the balance (the reservation's bed-hold balance including the charge) are in USD with two decimals, and the posting date is in year-month-day form. A receipt in this form means the charge is posted.

Errors: a `day_count` that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused with an error and nothing is posted; an `amount` that is not greater than zero is refused with an error and nothing is posted.
